headline: **MLB Daily Recap**
article:
The New York Mets dominated the Cincinnati Reds, securing a 9-1 victory behind Nolan McLean's 7.0 innings of scoreless relief with 9 strikeouts. The Kansas City Royals took down the Washington Nationals 6-2, led by Luinder Avila's 5.2 innings of work and Carter Jensen's 4-hit performance, including a home run. The Miami Marlins routed the Philadelphia Phillies 12-4, with Kyle Stowers leading the offense with a 4-hit, 2-home run performance.

Several key players are dealing with injuries, impacting their teams' lineups. Everson Pereira, the Chicago White Sox right fielder, has been placed on the 7-day injured list due to a concussion. Cole Ragans, the Kansas City Royals left-hander, has been placed on the 60-day injured list with left elbow impingement. Spencer Strider, the Atlanta Braves right-hander, has been transferred to the 60-day injured list with right elbow inflammation.

The Seattle Mariners traded RHP Randy Dobnak to the Kansas City Royals for cash, while the Toronto Blue Jays traded C Tyler Heineman to the Los Angeles Angels for cash. The Kansas City Royals also traded RHP Denis Samudio and cash to the Toronto Blue Jays for RHP Connor Seabold.

top_news.title: **Marlins Rout Phillies 12-4**
top_news.summary: The Miami Marlins dominated the Philadelphia Phillies, securing a 12-4 victory. Kyle Stowers led the Marlins' offense with a 4-hit, 2-home run performance, driving in 5 runs.

top_news.title: **Giants Take Down Braves in 7-2 Thriller**
top_news.summary: The San Francisco Giants secured a 7-2 victory over the Atlanta Braves, with Jung Hoo Lee leading the offense with a home run and two RBIs. Robbie Ray earned the win with 6.1 innings of scoreless relief, striking out eight and walking two.

top_news.title: **Giants Fall Short in Thrilling Tiebreaker**
top_news.summary: The San Francisco Giants were edged out by the Atlanta Braves in a 0-0 final score, with the Braves securing the win.

top_news.summary: Everson Pereira, the Chicago White Sox right fielder, has been placed on the 7-day injured list due to a concussion.
